title: Diversified lanthanide-directed self-assembly using a tritopic tetradentate acylhydrazone ligand

synthesis.procedure: An assembly formed using H6L3 and Eu(OTf)3 under neutral conditions. Red single crystals of the ligand-dissociation product were obtained after one week by slow vapor diffusion.

reagents.name: H6L3
reagents.amount: 2.51 mg, 3.50 µmol (1.0 equiv) for the precursor assembly

reagents.name: europium triflate
reagents.amount: 3.15 mg, 5.25 µmol (1.5 equiv) for the precursor assembly

synthesis.temperature: 50 °C for 1 h for the precursor assembly
synthesis.vessel_or_method: self-assembly followed by slow vapor diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Red single crystals formed by slow vapor diffusion.

source_locations.location: Self-assembly under neutral conditions; discussion of Fig. 3A
Section 2.1, synthesis of Eu6(H3L3)4 and crystallization of Eu6(H3L3′)6

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Six Eu(III) ions define an anti-triangular prism. Six partially dissociated H2L3′ ligands span its side faces; each Eu center binds three ligands and one water molecule. The crystal structure differs from the Eu6(H3L3)4 assembly identified in solution.

synthesis.procedure: H6L3 was stirred with La(OTf)3 in CD3OD/CD3CN at 50 °C under neutral conditions. The article also examined a 2:1 metal-to-ligand ratio, at which the relative abundance of the tetranuclear species increased. Single crystals were obtained by slow vapor diffusion over one week.

reagents.name: lanthanum triflate
reagents.amount: 1.5 equiv. initially; 2:1 metal-to-ligand ratio also examined

synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirring followed by slow vapor diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Suitable single crystals were obtained by slow vapor diffusion.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The four La centers are coplanar. Two acylhydrazone arms from each ligand bridge a pair of La centers, while the remaining arms coordinate the other La centers. The two bridged centers have opposite configurations, producing a mesocate architecture.

synthesis.procedure: The europium assembly was examined at an increased 2:1 metal-to-ligand ratio. Suitable single crystals of the tetranuclear product were obtained by slow vapor diffusion over one week.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: self-assembly followed by slow vapor diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Suitable single crystals were obtained by slow vapor diffusion.

source_locations.location: Self-assembly under neutral conditions; discussion of Fig. 3B and C

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The crystal structure is isostructural with La4(H3L3)2; both crystallize in triclinic P-1. It is a discrete tetranuclear assembly of two acylhydrazone ligands.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Homochiral hexanuclear cerium tetra-capped octahedral assembly

synthesis.procedure: Under basic conditions, prolonged heating of concentrated Ce6L3_4 yielded a brick-red precipitate. It was collected by centrifugation and redissolved in d6-DMSO for characterization. Crystals were obtained from an acetonitrile/methanol/water solution.

reagents.name: H6L3
reagents.amount: 200 µL of a 63 mg/mL DMSO solution, 17.53 µmol

reagents.name: cerium triflate
reagents.amount: 203 µL of an 80 mg/mL DMSO solution, 26.30 µmol (1.5 equiv)

reagents.name: tetraethylammonium hydroxide
reagents.amount: 62 µL of a 25 wt.% aqueous solution, 105.18 µmol (6 equiv)

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Brick-red precipitate collected by centrifugation; crystals obtained from acetonitrile/methanol/water.

source_locations.location: Self-assembly under basic conditions; discussion of Fig. 3D

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Four fully deprotonated tritopic ligands coordinate orthogonally to six Ce(III) centers to form a tetra-capped octahedron. All twelve chelating arms rotate in the same direction and the six Ce centers have the same configuration. One tetraethylammonium ion occupies the cavity; opposite-chirality octahedra associate into a crystallographic dimer.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Homochiral hexanuclear lanthanum tetra-capped octahedral assembly

synthesis.procedure: The homochiral lanthanum analogue was synthesized by the same prolonged-heating procedure described for the cerium assembly under basic conditions; detailed reagent quantities are not given in the main text.

reagents.name: H6L3
reagents.amount: 200 µL of a 63 mg/mL DMSO solution, 17.53 µmol in method A

reagents.name: lanthanum triflate
reagents.amount: 1.5 equiv in the analogous method A; La-specific mass and solution volume not stated

reagents.name: tetraethylammonium hydroxide
reagents.amount: 62 µL of a 25 wt.% aqueous solution, 105.18 µmol (6 equiv) in method A
